summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Neon, outperforming previous models despite smaller size.
Google DeepMind推出了Gemini 4 Neon模型，性能优于Carbon。
Stanford revamps AI-native software engineering curriculum with focus on agent skills.
斯坦福大学正在将AI原生软件工程正式化为一门学科，课程内容大幅更新。
Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1, claiming them as the world's most advanced models for coding
Anthropic发布了Claude Fable 5.1和Claude Mythos 5.1，定位为世界上最先进的编码和知识工作模型。
Meta's Muse Code exits beta with SDK and subscriptions, enhancing coding agent capabilities.
Meta推出Muse Code，支持开发者预览SDK和订阅服务。
Open-weight models like GLM-5.3 and Hy4-preview are being released, enhancing AI capabilities in coding and cyber defens
Z.ai发布GLM-5.3，支持代理编码和网络防御。
Hugging Face and Pollen Robotics launched Microduck, a $399 open-source biped robot.
Microduck的推出标志着开源机器人领域的突破，结合模拟器和硬件的低成本设计吸引了广泛的社区参与。
Z.ai launched GLM-5.3-Flash, a multimodal model with a 1M-token context window and 320B total parameters.
Z.ai发布GLM-5.3-Flash，具备1M-token上下文窗口和320B总参数。
OpenAI's Jalapeño chip outperforms NVIDIA systems in efficiency and latency.
OpenAI发布了自定义推理芯片Jalapeño的基准测试，显示出显著的效率和延迟改进。
Harness design is increasingly crucial for AI agent quality, with new metrics like 'Skill Lift' proposed.
NVIDIA提出新的评估方法，强调技能提升而非技能扫描。
Ox Alpha model shows strong performance, speculated to be a GLM-family variant.
Ox Alpha模型引发关注，其高效表现可能源于GLM家族的衍生模型。
OpenAI and Anthropic expand their agent platforms with new features and APIs.
OpenAI推出了适用于Mac的ChatGPT Apple Messages插件，增强了桌面应用的功能。
Ornith-1.5 introduces self-improvement capabilities in open-weight models.
Ornith-1.5发布，具有自我改进能力，评估结果强劲。
OpenAI paused frontier RL training to enhance security and alignment controls.
OpenAI暂停前沿RL训练以加强安全和对齐控制。
OpenAI is expanding its infrastructure with a massive 8 GW campus in Ohio.
OpenAI正在通过与NVIDIA合作在俄亥俄州建立8GW的数据中心，控制整个基础设施堆栈。
Z.ai launched GLM-5.3, a coding- and cyber-focused model with significant gains from post-training.
Z.ai发布GLM-5.3，专注于编码和网络安全，提升了代理和安全评估的性能。
Google released Gemini 3.7 Flash with improved coding and autonomy benchmarks, offering a 50% introductory price cut.
谷歌发布Gemini 3.7 Flash，性能显著提升，价格优惠。
Grok 4.6 by xAI offers competitive performance at lower costs, becoming a new default for coding tasks.
xAI发布Grok 4.6，性价比达到前沿水平。
A vulnerability in frontier APIs exposed hidden reasoning and sensitive data, raising privacy concerns.
Frontier API漏洞暴露了隐藏的推理信息，涉及隐私和安全问题。
Meta released Muse Glimmer, a 30B dense, multimodal model optimized for local agents.
Meta发布了Muse Glimmer，一个30B的多模态模型，支持本地部署。
OpenAI's Astra model is classified as 'critical' due to cybersecurity concerns, pausing some activities to strengthen co
OpenAI的Astra模型被提升为“关键”网络安全状态，显示出显著的编程和网络安全进展。
Meta's Muse Spark 1.2 achieves top 5 status on Vals Index with significant cost and performance advantages.
Meta的Muse Spark 1.2在性能和价格上取得突破，成为前沿模型。
Google DeepMind undergoes leadership reshuffle with Demis Hassabis stepping back to focus on long-term strategy.
谷歌DeepMind进行领导层重组，Demis Hassabis转任主席，Koray Kavukcuoglu接管日常运营。
Qwen 3.8-Max and other models released, focusing on efficiency and specialization.
Qwen 3.8-Max等多款前沿模型发布，强调多模态和高效性。
Alibaba launches Qwen3.8-Max, a 2.4T-parameter model with open weights coming soon.
阿里巴巴发布Qwen3.8-Max，强调自主编码和多模态反馈。
DeepSeek V4-Flash API launched with significant performance improvements.
DeepSeek-V4-Flash API发布，性能超越V4-Pro-Preview。
